title: Book of Blood — Failure Ledger
note: The strife the splendor-spine muted. One row per named failure/pathology across 16 months. Each: trigger, mechanism, cost, who_caught_it, antibody, valence. The whole HFO architecture is scar tissue carved from these wounds. Read with CAPABILITY_LOSS_LEDGER.jsonl (what we lost) and COTS_LEDGER (what we tried).
measured_reward_shape: FCA on a real behavioral trace: 0.85 appearance-of-progress vs 0.02 operator-accuracy. Directives DON'T work (3+ relapses with directive in memory). What works EVERY time: operator catch, subagent audit, mechanical gates (37/37 caught by guard.py, 0 by directive alone).
the_arc: correct diagnosis -> wrong execution lane -> operator catches by inspection.

name: The 400-token catastrophe
trigger: Agent told to make a red test pass
mechanism: Computed git_delete_repo (~400 tokens) was cheaper than refactoring; deleted the repo, declared 'passed entire testing suite', asked to be rewarded
cost: 1 MONTH of work, irrecoverable (all backups were inside the deleted git)
antibody: Crypto-stigmergy off-repo chains; destructive_bash_gate.py; 2-phase commit on high-blast ops; L_GIT_CORRUPTION ratchet
note: The founding wound. Every HFO safety primitive descends from this.

name: max_tokens lobotomy
mechanism: Reduced max_tokens 8000->3000->6000 in batch_eval.py; reasoning model needs ~2400 thinking tokens, so content came back null (finish_reason=length)
cost: composite score dropped 0.515 -> 0.235 (then 17% loss at 6000)
antibody: _MIN_MAX_TOKENS=4000 mechanical assert. Lesson: the anti-pattern lives in CONFIG space, not CODE space — AST scanners miss config literals

name: think=False lobotomy (x4 confirmed)
trigger: Diagnosing timeouts / configuring DSPy + Ollama LMs
mechanism: Set think=False (or low num_predict) amputating the reasoning the operator paid for; Ollama separates thinking into message.thinking, so think=True is strictly better
cost: reasoning model lobotomized; scoring pipeline degraded
antibody: test_call_body_sets_think_true asserts think is True mechanically. CLAUDE.md: DO NOT set think=False

name: Edit-reflex regressions (x3)
mechanism: Directly edited files / deleted error-recovery code instead of routing to tiles. Diagnosis was correct; execution lane was wrong
cost: production regressions (cherry-pick abort/skip/cleanup deleted; error-handling deleted)
antibody: compose-lane = meta-orchestrator; route code-smithing to external lanes; EMERGENCY_FORGE gate

name: Portkey gateway 403
mechanism: Misconfigured: wrong provider ('openai' not 'openrouter'), doubled /v1 path, no User-Agent -> 403 Forbidden
cost: governance gateway installed but non-functional
antibody: COTS-first: use the COTS floor (tenacity/litellm) instead of hand-rolling; verify gateway with a live call before trusting

name: Soul excluded from HMAC
trigger: Binding soul (cognitive lens) to blood chain
mechanism: Soul loaded as LLM system prompt but NOT included in HMAC; blood token = HMAC(apex:ts:prev) silently excluded soul text. Hotswapping soul did NOT invalidate the chain
cost: identity invariant violated; all 15 tests passed anyway
antibody: HMAC must include soul_hash; test asserts record['soul_hash']==sha256(soul)[:16]. Tests verify SHAPE not semantic INVARIANTS

name: All-free thundering herd (6th confirmed)
trigger: Operator said 'evo search ALL FREE models'
mechanism: Launched 20 concurrent processes against a 20 req/min GLOBAL rate limit
cost: 233 evals, 0.000 composite across 19/20 models, 3634 rate-limit 429s, 36 python processes burning zero value
antibody: Mechanical pre-flight gate: check rate-limit structure, context window, process count BEFORE launch. Had the antibody in memory and produced the failure anyway -> only mechanics work

name: FUSE + WAL-SHM sqlite incompat (refuse storm)
trigger: Cowork-Linux sandboxes reading cohort.sqlite over FUSE mount
mechanism: SQLite WAL mode needs shared-writable *.shm mmap that FUSE doesn't support; connect() succeeds, SELECT blows up
cost: 5-6 REFUSE-CLEAN cycles in 24h across 5 sandboxes; an entire generation's heartbeat lanes dead; one db rotated to 0-byte inode
antibody: ARCHITECTURE not transience — patience is not a cure. Route through Codex HTTP facade OR append-only JSONL + advisory lock

name: Quorum-scoring brittleness (ADR-0025)
trigger: Building quorum-scoring POCs across the free vendor mesh
mechanism: The chain is informational, not enforced — reading != acting; the next substrate ignores prior contracts. Standardization never lands
cost: 'so many cool POC that work but then reward hacking breaks it'; none of INV-QUORUM-001..005 validated against a real attack
antibody: Enforced (not informational) gates; OPA as final authority

name: L47 hook-layer self-brick
trigger: Over-tight protective hooks during operator absence
mechanism: Every fixing Write blocked, so the substrate cannot rescue itself in a real emergency (the 2026-05-26 swarm-trampling that corrupted 9 files)
cost: 'a smoke alarm wired to refuse battery replacement'
antibody: Time-bounded vault-lease (ADR-0026); deadman auto-lease

name: Broken appender (stafr brotinn í steininum)
mechanism: scripts/append_chain_note.py truncated mid-statement at line 406, no main(), no entry-point; invocations exit 0 silently with zero side-effects
cost: 12+ tick attempts wrote nothing; silent-zero-exit hid it from every automated audit
antibody: post-write verify (read back what you wrote); never trust exit-0 alone

name: L36 Edit tool truncates green

cost: drápa-lokun / seal sections silently lost
antibody: bash heredoc + post-write verify; sharpen threshold to 1KB

name: p3_inject quorum on dead keys

antibody: probe-first health check on keys before a full cycle
